purpose: Defines the sanitized text summary format for future real Browser/E2E staging analysis before any real staging URL, browser automation, cookies, screenshots, or user data are connected.
allowed_input: route label or synthetic/stable route name, not full private URL
console error summaries with secrets removed
network error summaries with secrets removed
forbidden_input: real staging URLs unless explicitly approved
full request/response bodies unless sanitized and approved
server IPs and private endpoints unless explicitly approved
acceptance_criteria_rules: criteria must be observable from sanitized summary
criteria must not require hidden secrets or private data
model report must distinguish missing evidence from failure
rules: fixture success does not authorize unsanitized staging data
real staging summaries must pass this contract before model analysis
default model path is Qwen/DeepSeek required providers
Gemini remains experimental for E2E text until it passes reliably
no browser automation is added by this contract
no real staging secrets are stored in repository
next_steps: create sanitized staging summary example using fake data
add manual validator for summary JSON
then connect browser automation only after staging access rules are approved
